purpose: Trace every current ETA CETa competency row and every Alfred career standard to an explicit teaching, practice, assessment, mastery, and practical-evidence route.

Alfred questions are original course practice, not official ETA questions and not externally psychometrically validated.
Virtual work cannot prove tactile instrument, soldering, harness, assembly, or physical board-debugging skill.
Official standards, exam rules, and external links can change and require periodic re-verification.
